# kickstart, fixup, research, publish

Default publish is `none`. Do not stack another kickstart on uncommitted
kickstart work. If `plans/*.plan.md` exists and the tree is dirty, stop and ask
before stacking another kickstart.

## kickstart argv

Common prompt: `{issue url} can you kickstart this?` Resolve argv; do not quiz
for CLI defaults.

1. **Full issue URL** as positional (not a bare number).
2. Compare URL `owner/repo` to workspace
   (`gh repo view --json nameWithOwner -q .nameWithOwner`). If different, pass
   `--allow-cross-repo` (`-A`). Do not ask; mention in summary. If workspace repo
   unknown, pass `-A` for full URLs anyway.
3. Extra guidance besides URL → `--steer "…"`.
4. Named/attached files → `--context-file` (repeatable).
5. Defaults unless user asked otherwise:
   - `--publish none` unless PR or direct (see Publish)
   - nested agent from project config / `DN_AGENT` (outer harness: do not pass
     `--agent` unless asked)
   - omit `--cursor-cloud`, `--sandbox`, `--milestone`, `--complete`, `--once`,
     `--skip-plan`, `--verbosity`, `--workspace-root`, `--denoise-task`
6. `/pull/` URL → `dn fixup`, not kickstart. Local `.md` → kickstart that path.
   Denoise task URL (`denoise.cloud/task/` or `/t/`) → kickstart that URL.
7. Dirty tree + existing `plans/*.plan.md` → ask before another kickstart.

```bash
dn kickstart https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
dn kickstart --allow-cross-repo https://github.com/other/repo/issues/123
dn kickstart --steer "Focus on the parser" https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
```

After local (`none`) success → ask before commit.

## Publish intent

| User says | Argv | After success |
| --- | --- | --- |
| open/create PR, `--awp`, `--publish pr` | `--publish pr` | Report PR URL; do not commit in chat |
| publish direct, push trunk in kickstart | `--publish direct` | Report branch; no commit here unless asked |
| "publish" without PR vs direct | Ask which | — |

`--awp` = `--publish pr`. Direct mode commits/pushes default branch inside
kickstart (lint only); it is not `dn sync`.

```bash
dn kickstart --publish pr https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
dn kickstart --publish direct https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
```

## research

For code pointers / affected files before planning in-chat (not `dn meld` for
`dn loop`):

1. Full GitHub issue URL or full Denoise task URL only.
2. Read validated markdown from **stdout** (stderr = progress).
3. `-A` when issue repo ≠ workspace (same as kickstart).
4. Optional `-o plans/foo.research.md` for later `--context-file`.

```bash
dn research https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123
dn research https://denoise.cloud/task/<uuid>
```

After `dn fixup`, ask before committing (same as kickstart).
